prompt: Iris arrives at 6:30 p.m. on Thursday and wants to take her coat and approve the cuffs. What can she do on that visit?
promptZh: Iris 星期四晚上六點半抵達，想領大衣並核准修改袖口。這次到店她能做什麼？

options.text: Collect the coat and sign the cuff work order at the side door.
options.zh: 在側門領大衣並簽署袖口工單。
options.whyZh: 側門只處理付清的領件，不核准新工作。

options.text: Collect the coat at the side door, then return during front-counter hours to approve the cuffs.
options.zh: 從側門領大衣，改在前方櫃檯的營業時間回來核准袖口施工。
options.whyZh: 星期四側門延後領件，下襬已付清；但新工作只能在前方櫃檯核准。

options.text: Approve the cuffs, but leave the coat until both changes are complete.
options.zh: 核准袖口施工，但把大衣留到兩項修改都完成。
options.whyZh: 六點半不能核准新工作，而且可以先帶走大衣。

options.text: Do neither, because partial work cannot be picked up.
options.zh: 兩項都不能做，因為部分完工不能領件。
options.whyZh: 領件單明寫可在未決定袖口前帶走大衣。

explanationZh: 星期四側門延後領件，下襬已付清；但新工作只能在前方櫃檯核准。
evidence: You can take the coat home now without deciding about the cuffs. … late pickup is only for work already paid for. Use the front counter to approve any new work.

vocabulary.note: 正式同意開始新的工作。
